I cut my tea from six cups a day to two. That's it. That was the whole plan.
Four cups at fifteen rupees is sixty rupees a day. Small enough that I don't miss it.
Since February, every rupee of that tea money went into one stock. Tourism Finance Corporation. T F C I.
Two hundred and sixty days. One thousand and forty cups of tea skipped. Fifteen thousand six hundred rupees invested.
For five months, nothing happened. The stock moved sideways, and my tea money just sat there.
Then July came. T F C I started climbing, from about seventy five rupees to over one fifty.
Today, my fifteen thousand six hundred is worth twenty eight thousand five hundred. Almost thirteen thousand in profit. Plus eighty three percent.
And I'm not selling. After one year, each buy turns long term, and gains under one and a quarter lakh a year are tax free.
Four cups of tea. That's all it took. What small habit would you swap for a stock? Follow for more Real P and L.
